name: Conrad Bengaluru
insider_take: Bengaluru's skyline finds its finest address at Conrad Bengaluru — where Silicon Valley meets Indian elegance in one of Asia's fastest-growing tech capitals.
whats_special: Positioned in the heart of Bellandur , Bengaluru's premier business corridor, Conrad Bengaluru offers seamless access to the city's top tech parks including Ecospace and RMZ Ecospace. The hotel features 290 luxuriously appointed rooms and suites , many boasting panoramic views of the Bengaluru skyline and Bellandur Lake. Home to five distinct dining destinations , including Mikusu — an acclaimed Japanese restaurant — and The Spice Traders, celebrating bold South Asian flavors. As part of Hilton's Luxury Portfolio , guests enjoy access to the exclusive Hilton Honors rewards program with elevated perks.
pro_tip: Book a room on an upper floor for sweeping views of Bellandur Lake — especially magical at sunrise when morning mist rolls across the water. Ask about the hotel's wellness butler service to customize your spa and fitness experience before arrival.
dont_miss: Mikusu Restaurant — One of Bengaluru's top Japanese dining experiences, featuring an omakase menu crafted by world-class chefs. The Rooftop Pool — A stunning infinity-style pool offering sweeping city views, perfect for unwinding after long business meetings or city exploration. Nearby Cubbon Park — Just a short drive away, this lush 300-acre urban park is Bengaluru's green lung and a beloved local escape.
pros: Prime location in Bangalore's business district with excellent connectivity
Sophisticated luxury accommodations with contemporary Indian design elements
Multiple acclaimed dining venues featuring international and local cuisine
cons: Urban setting may lack resort-style ambiance
